name: Jie Lishi
source: Decides to possess the protagonist after being injured and ambushed by cultivators. She remains in a spirit-like state during the possession and assists the protagonist (mainly for her own life). Their lives have since been tied together; the protagonist is required to have sex with a female cultivator every 30 days or else they will both perish.
